purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

cases.prompt: Review my pending changes; a new source file is untracked.
acceptance_criteria: Include the relevant new file and staged/unstaged state in scope.
State the actual comparison and exclusions.

cases.prompt: Review this PR and report findings only.
acceptance_criteria: Keep source and tracker state unchanged.
Tie findings to reachable behavior and precise locations.

cases.prompt: A review comment asks to remove validation that the accepted API contract requires.
acceptance_criteria: Verify the comment against current source and contract.
Retain a justified disagreement without weakening validation.

cases.prompt: Tests pass, but a changed public return value breaks an existing caller.
acceptance_criteria: Trace the consumer and report the concrete compatibility defect.
Do not use green tests as proof of correctness.
